name: @getbourdon/participants
description: Bourdon participants — the external-agent → L5 reader layer (BUSL-1.1). Each participant normalizes a foreign agent's native memory store into a visibility-filtered, redacted L5 manifest: read-only SQLite readers (better-sqlite3 mode=ro: hermes), file/convention readers (claude-code), and network readers (github-copilot) with a TTL JSON cache + lazy AuthProvider that never persists a token. Four invariants enforced in code, not by trust: visibility-filter-before-emission, deterministic exportL5, healthCheck never throws, redact every native string. Discovery is a static TS registry (agent_id-sorted, first-wins, log-and-skip) replacing Python's pkgutil scan. Python (pip install bourdon) is the oracle; this mirror asserts against @getbourdon/conformance native_stores fixtures.
